title: A check refuses a duplicate slug in docs/debts/notes.md, and the nine pairs on main are merged
why: docs/debts/notes.md on main e2703c611 has 9 slugs that each appear twice with different text: command-in-item-str-replace, handoff-unread, lane-force-push-refused, mistake-check-plain-fault-words, opus-plain-ask, ps1-copy-skill-prune-no-backup, rm-shim-bypass-forms, rm-shim-glob-passes and sweep-fetch-fail-wrong-cause. The #1449 main merge made 4 of them, and only a fix check caught those; no lint refuses a duplicate slug (lane notes-fix-guard-1, 04:33 CST Nov 8).
note: Fix: a notes lint refuses a slug that appears twice, red case first on two lines with one slug; then merge each of the nine pairs' text into one line. Queue fix (owner 13:20 CST Nov 7: a found gap gets a fix). Filed 04:35 CST Nov 8; Lane notes-fix-guard-1 (session_013NEJL3G6vFtN2TjNZrMETW), the lane that found it, builds it (coordinator, 04:34 CST Nov 8; owner item 386). The lint change is a check change, so it gets a review. Keep each pair's text that is still true. Second incident (lane draft-pr-guard-heredoc, 04:45 CST Nov 8): merging #1820's head into #1863 merged docs/debts/notes.md by union (.gitattributes `merge=union`). That restored five retired heredoc-keep notes and kept two copies of five more, one with the opposite premise; a fix-check reviewer caught it, and fae8e4f7b fixes it. lint/check_record_slugs.py skips the notes file. That lane's suggested step notes-duplicate-slug-lint is folded here. Ready as #1920 (head cddd3fde8), with runner 8; round 3 PASS (sonnet), net value positive. Open notes only: a row says "only gh_edit_hit reads it", but key_named_hit and reworked_hit read it too; the CI step name "Record slug length" is stale (lane, 05:36 CST Nov 8). Sighting: lane one-home-check (session_013NEJKzbDHRpreufhWY48Vb) also counts 9 duplicate note ids on main (coordinator, 05:46 CST Nov 8). Sighting 09:28 CST Nov 8 (lane timing-tests, session_013NEJL1jPC89ae6X6Pa4jmf, proposed step union-merge-revives-notes): merging #2002's head into #2081 kept an old copy of a note both sides rewrote, and revived a note #2081 had deleted; only a fix check caught it. The two-copies half is a duplicate slug, which this step's check refuses once it merges. Sighting 11:27 CST Nov 8 (lane record-claim-cites-code, proposed step notes-slug-once): merging #1893's new head into #2108 with merge=union kept two copies of note stale010-doc-relative-cite (f1b1f1db5 lines 1518 and 1521); a haiku fix check caught it and forced a fresh 3-round chain on #2108; fixed at 165d20126. The lane asks that the record be decision notes-merge-union's Known cost paragraph, which says "No incident yet, so no check". Second incident 11:28 CST Nov 8 (lane record-claim-cites-code): on #2117, notes stale010-subfolder-relative-cite and stale010-new-top-folder-silent came back twice after a union merge; round 3 caught it. Main 422cbbdfe holds 9 duplicate slugs (command-in-item-str-replace, handoff-unread, lane-force-push-refused, mistake-check-plain-fault-words, opus-plain-ask, ps1-copy-skill-prune-no-backup, rm-shim-bypass-forms, rm-shim-glob-passes, sweep-fetch-fail-wrong-cause): dedupe them first, or judge added lines only.
